From the Supervisor of Elections reports of current officeholders and 2026 candidates. Gifts from the company's owners or employees as individuals are not linked to it, and individual donors are never named on this site. "Same government" means the official serves on (or the candidate is running for) a government that pays this vendor. A campaign gift near a vote, or from a company that holds a contract, is a fact in two public records. It does not show why anyone voted the way they did, or how a contract was awarded.

Votes that approved its contracts

How each member voted, from the minutes
  • 2026-08-25 · Panama City Commission: Approved consent items including a $1.2 million stormwater contract · $1.20M · passed 4-0 Minutes
    Allan Branch yes · Robbie Hughes yes · Janice Lucas absent · Brian Grainger yes · Josh Street yes
    Approves: SRF Baker Court utility and roadway improvements (PC25-038), change order 3 ($181,826, 2026-08-25). Matched by vendor name, item number, agenda item.
  • 2025-09-23 · Panama City Commission: Awarded Baker Court utility and roadway bid to ECSC, LLC · $3.11M · passed 5-0 Minutes
    Allan Branch yes · Robbie Hughes yes · Janice Lucas yes · Brian Grainger yes · Josh Street yes
    Approves: Bid PC25-038, SRF Baker Court utility and roadway improvements (up to $3,112,274.68 with contingency) ($2.96M, 2025-09-23). Matched by vendor name, item number, agenda item.
  • 2024-12-17 · Bay County Board of County Commissioners: Awarded Redwood Avenue drainage contract to ECSC, LLC · $1.84M · passed 5-0 Minutes
    Daniel Raffield yes (got a gift) · Robert Carroll yes · Doug Crosby yes (got a gift) · Douglas Moore yes · Clair Pease yes
    Approves: Contract 24-50, Redwood Avenue drainage improvements ($1.84M, 2024-12-17). Matched by vendor name, item number, agenda item, amount.

Votes are linked to a contract when the same government voted within 45 days and the minutes agree with the agenda record in at least two ways (company name, bid number, project words or amount). Many contracts are approved on a consent agenda with routine items in one vote. A campaign gift near a vote, or from a company that holds a contract, is a fact in two public records. It does not show why anyone voted the way they did, or how a contract was awarded.

About this page

  • Awards are agenda amounts, not money paid. Register and tourism-agency payments come from the lists each source publishes, which cover only part of each year.
  • CRA records that the ledger leaves out of its totals (parts of a larger project, or not CRA money) are listed but not added up.
  • Vendor id ecsc in the downloads (column vendor_id).

Spellings combined because: Agendas give both names together: "ECSC, LLC (Emerald Coast Site Construction)" and "Emerald Coast Site Construction (ECSC)".
